sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to extend their excellent run. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and have won their last five matches, establishing a commanding position. However, they face Alsager Town, who are struggling badly at the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 games and on a five-game losing streak, making this a significant opportunity for Sandbach to maintain their momentum.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could affect the title race, with Stafford just two points behind the leaders. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, face Eccleshall at home in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a match between two mid-table sides. Bilston Town (6th) entertain Foley Meir, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United; both sides have reasonable recent form. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a fixture between clubs in the lower half. Telford Town face a tough away trip to Cheadle Heath Nomads, with both teams among the division's poorest performers. Crewe host Allscott Heath in another bottom-half encounter. Brereton Social face Widnes Town at home against a side pointless from seven games, presenting Brereton with a chance to climb the table.
